privacy.ai_training_note: Privacy policy does not explicitly address whether uploaded photos or their metadata are used to train the colorization AI model. Policy states files are 'deleted shortly after' providing results, but does not clarify if data or derivatives are retained for model improvement. No opt-out mechanism for AI training mentioned.

products.name: Colorize
products.data_scope: Uploaded photos (temporarily during processing), email, name, phone (optional), payment data, usage metadata
products.notes: Consumer-facing photo colorization tool. Free tier with 1 credit/month, subscription tiers ($72/year = 480 credits), and one-time credit purchases ($49-$500). Files deleted after processing. No account required for basic use.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium subscription + one-time credits; Free tier: 1 monthly credit; Subscription: $72/year (480 credits); One-time: $49-$500 depending on credit quantity
compare.data_residency: Portugal (company location); specific processing location not documented
